title: Potato Leek Soup
cScaleSummary: C1 because the meaningful cholesterol contributor is the chicken stock used to cook the barley and build the soup. The potatoes, leeks, onion, mushrooms, barley, olive oil, herbs, and lemon juice do not contribute cholesterol, so the per-serving cholesterol remains low.
ldlActiveSummary: LDL-Active because the soup is built around vegetables and barley, uses modest unsaturated oil, and develops flavor through caramelization, mushroom browning, blending, herbs, and acid rather than cream or heavy animal fat. Its structure is hearty and supportive of LDL lowering.
intro: This keeps the classic leek and potato foundation but borrows a deeper, slower technique from French onion soup and Alpine mushroom cookery. By building caramelized onion directly into the base and layering in browned mushrooms, the soup gains structure and depth without relying on cream.

items.prep: cleaned and sliced (white and light green only)

miseEnPlace: Prepare {{ingredient:leeks}} as specified: cleaned and sliced (white and light green only).
Prepare {{ingredient:yukon-gold-potatoes}} as specified: peeled and 1/2-inch diced.

stepGroups.title: Build the Onion Paste
items: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-low.
Add sliced onion and salt.
Cook slowly 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deep golden brown, soft, and jammy.
If it sticks, add small splashes of water and keep going.
Blend or mash into a smooth paste. Leave in the pot.

stepGroups.title: Sear the Mushrooms
items: In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium-high.
Add mushrooms in a single layer.
Do not stir at first. Let them brown hard.
Cook 6 to 8 minutes until deeply browned, reduced, and slightly crisp at edges.
Season lightly. Set aside.

stepGroups.title: Cook the Barley
items: Simmer barley in 4 cups stock for 25 to 30 minutes until tender.
Drain, reserving the liquid.

stepGroups.title: Build the Aromatic Layer
items: To the onion paste pot, add sliced leeks.
Cook 8 to 10 minutes until softened and integrated into the paste.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

stepGroups.title: Build the Soup
items: Add potatoes, bay leaf, pepper, and 3 cups stock.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are fully tender.

stepGroups.title: Create the Structure
items: Remove bay leaf.
Blend 50 to 60 percent of the soup.
You want a thicker, cohesive base.

stepGroups.title: Fold in the Barley and Mushrooms
items: Add the cooked barley and about 2/3 of the mushrooms to the pot.
Add a splash of the reserved barley liquid if needed to loosen the texture.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes so the flavors absorb into the base.
Adjust consistency with additional stock as needed.

stepGroups.title: Crispy Barley Finish
items: Take about 1/3 of the cooked barley and pat dry.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Cook barley 6 to 8 minutes until golden and crisp in spots.
Salt lightly.

stepGroups.title: Finish
items: Turn off heat.
Stir in parsley, thyme, and lemon juice.
Taste and adjust salt.
Optional: small hit of fish sauce or soy for added depth.

stepGroups.title: Serve
items: Ladle into bowls.
Top with remaining mushrooms and crispy barley.
Do not fully stir.
